_doc: The only list of things a person must do. Each item is an act only the owner can perform (identity-bound) and carries exactly one link that does it. Everything else self-resolves. Rendered into NEEDS-YOU.md by `python3 -m foundation needsyou`; tests require https links and no file paths.
done_for_you: Old Cloudflare account: the tick, site and dashboard keep running there.
Entity and the org admin token are not needed now; entity-only programmes stay deferred until you choose one.
Connect GitHub: settled 2026-11-20 on its own evidence (env:LANE_PAT|LANE_APP_ID or http:https://ultrastable.io/connect/github ~ GitHub is connected).
Allow repository settings (archiving and the main-branch check rule): settled 2026-11-20 on its own evidence (http:https://ultrastable.io/connect/github-admin ~ Repository settings are allowed).

Submit funding applications: closed 2026-11-20 under Rowan's standing order ('I will do nothing'); default in effect permanently: Kits stay unsent; the credential-free channels (MCP registry, IndexNow) keep promoting without you. Record: doctrine/open-loops.json gate owner-funding.

Move the four ultrastable domains to the Ultrastable account: closed 2026-11-20 under Rowan's standing order ('I will do nothing'); default in effect permanently: The quniverse account keeps serving the four domains and their pages; nothing breaks, and the Ultrastable loops keep running on their own account. Record: doctrine/open-loops.json gate owner-domains-move.

Upload the org avatar and pin repos: closed 2026-11-20 under Rowan's standing order ('I will do nothing'); default in effect permanently: Generated identicon, no pins. Record: doctrine/open-loops.json gate owner-org-brand.

Sign in to Bluesky again: closed 2026-11-20 under Rowan's standing order ('I will do nothing'); default in effect permanently: Posting stays dry-run; the repo, registry pull requests and feeds carry the work. Record: doctrine/open-loops.json gate owner-social.

Register the Google and Buffer sign-in apps: closed 2026-11-20 under Rowan's standing order ('I will do nothing'); default in effect permanently: the wizard keeps its account-creation links for Google and Buffer; nothing is typed or stored. Record: doctrine/open-loops.json gate owner-oauth-apps.
